sentences.text: In these petitions, the grievance of the Petitioners is that areca nuts, which according to the Petitioners are non-edible, were seized on (2) 932 wp 8575.25 28.04.2025 and 01.05.2025.
Huge quantity of the said material was seized.

3. Reliance is placed on Section 42(2) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, to contend that upon analysis of samples of such material a report was to be generated within 14 days to be sent to the Designated Officer with a copy to the Commissioner of Food Safety.
Thereupon, further action could be taken under the said provision.

4. It is the specific case of the Petitioners that after seizure of the aforesaid goods, as far back on 28.04.2025 the Petitioners had moved representations before the concerned Authorities for release of their seized goods, inter alia on the ground that the same are perishable.
It is stated that there is neither any response to the said representations nor is copy of any report furnished to the Petitioners.
5. In view of the aforesaid contentions raised on behalf of the Petitioners, issue notice to the Respondents, returnable on 07.08.2025.
To be taken up in the urgent orders category.
Mr. Bhosle learned counsel waives notice on behalf of Respondent Nos.1 & 2.

The learned AGP waives notice on behalf of Respondent Nos.3 to 7.
 [Y.G. KHOBRAGADE, J.] [MANISH PITALE, J.]
